audit.body: 373 rules checked page by page: indexing, tags, internal links, speed, structured data and accessibility, with a clear report.

rank.title: Rankings and keywords
rank.body: Google rank tracking, keyword research, competitor analysis and local SEO.

content.title: Optimised writing
content.body: Articles and pages written for your readers and for search engines: outline, search intent, content score and internal links.

publish.title: Publishing
publish.body: Publish to WordPress, export for your CMS, social posts and newsletters, all from the same place.

quote.title: Quotes and invoicing
quote.body: A priced quote built from the issues the audit found, then the invoice, with nothing typed twice.

portal.title: Client space
portal.body: Your reports, quotes, articles and invoices online at any time, with an assistant that explains the results.

landing.methodTitle: A simple method, in four steps
landing.methodBody: You always know where your site stands, what has been done and what comes next.

one.title: Audit
one.body: We analyse your site in depth and measure your visibility, on Google and in AI assistants.

two.title: Plan and quote
two.body: Issues are ranked by severity. You get an action plan and a clear quote.

three.title: Fixes and content
three.body: We fix, write and publish the content that moves your site forward.

four.title: Tracking and reports
four.body: Rankings, traffic and audit score are tracked over time, with regular reports.

landing.portalTitle: A clear client space, without jargon
landing.portalBody: Every client gets their own secure space, with the progress of their SEO and all of their documents, without having to ask for them.

portalPoints.assistant: An assistant that answers your questions

landing.aiTitle: Visible on Google, and in AI answers
landing.aiBody: Your customers also ask ChatGPT, Perplexity or Gemini. We measure whether your site is cited there and optimise it so that it is.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to see where your site stands?
landing.ctaBody: Sign in to follow your SEO, or write to us to start with an audit.
